propositions: test_contended_index_lock_cleared_during_backoff_succeeds uses a wall-clock threading.Timer that can unlink git's real index.lock while git commit is holding it, causing StoreError: fatal: unable to write new index file on slow runners

the planted test lock is reclaimed on first retry under force_reclaim=True, so git commit creates its own real index.lock; the timer at t=0.4 then deletes whatever lock exists rather than only the planted one
the test fails reproducibly on macOS py3.13 CI under load (23m24s vs 12m Linux legs) because git commit takes longer than the 0.4s timer window
root cause is test-local race condition (test-timing) and timer identity blindness, not production backoff defect or runner resource exhaustion
replacing threading.Timer with gitutil._retry_probe deterministic probe releases the planted lock only after confirmed first failure, with no wall clock and no ability to delete git's real lock
